positioning.program: Project S.P.H.E.R.E. is a staged experimental research program designed to subject unconventional or source-inspired hypotheses to conventional scientific measurement, metrology, uncertainty analysis, adversarial controls, preregistration, reproducible analysis, fresh confirmation, and independent replication. The program does not assume that its motivating hypotheses are correct.
positioning.loc1: LOC-1 is a theory-neutral differential mechanical-resonance experiment testing for a reproducible position-associated residual under controlled conditions. A detected residual would constitute an observation requiring further investigation rather than evidence of a specific mechanism.
positioning.antB01: ANT-B-01 is a passive electromagnetic resonator experiment designed to characterize the behavior of concentric conductive shells and structured internal geometry against conventional electromagnetic models, matched controls, calibrated network measurements, thermal measurements, and complete energy accounting.
positioning.shortDisclaimer: Hypotheses are not findings. Project S.P.H.E.R.E. has no experimental measurements or results yet. A position-associated residual is not a mechanism, and resonance or stored energy is not energy generation.
positioning.spherevlNotice: SPHEREVL (Control Room) is a Level 0 educational simulation, not physical measurements or scientific validation.
positioning.fundingNotice: Contributions do not purchase equity, tokens, royalties, or a financial return. No DAO, token sale, or IP-NFT commitment exists.

Goodman's separate portfolio and IT/AI consulting services at michaelpgoodman.com and any unrelated hosted business pages are independent of Project S.P.H.E.R.E. and do not constitute scientific evidence or endorsement.

motivatingExperimentBase.source: Bashar material presented by Darryl Anka (source-inspired hypothesis only; not established physics and no implied endorsement)
motivatingExperimentBase.table: Ultra-flat table, 6 to 10 feet long (1.83 to 3.05 m)
motivatingExperimentBase.artifact: Very thin hollow copper sphere, 3 to 4 inches in diameter (76.2 to 101.6 mm), as round as practicable
motivatingExperimentBase.coreTest: Excite mechanical vibrations at Position A, measure resonant frequency with high precision, relocate to Position B, repeat measurement, and evaluate the differential frequency contrast.
motivatingExperimentBase.outOfScopeSpeculation: Claims regarding acoustic/EM bombardment causing rolling or instantaneous relocation, charting a universal vibrational matrix/C-chart, or electromagnetic-gravitational bubbles are explicitly excluded from Phase 1 LOC-1 and treated as untested speculative conjecture.
